'''Tisane ma Louisa''' ({{lang|ar|شاي ماء لويزة}}, ''Louisa's Water Remedy Tea'') is an Algerian herbal remedy tea.

== Ingredients ==
* 2 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] (around 3 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]]) dried [[Cookbook:Lemon Verbena|verbena leaves]]
* 250 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]] water
* ½ [[Cookbook:Each|ea]]. [[Cookbook:Lemon|lemon]], juiced
* [[Cookbook:Sugar|Sugar]] to taste (optional)

== Procedure ==
# Heat the water in a saucepan and bring it to a [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]].
# Add the verbena leaves to the boiling water.
# Let the verbena leaves steep in water for about 10 minutes.
# Stir the leaves in the water (attempt to crush them as small as possible), then strain out the leaves.
# Add the lemon juice and sugar.
